mentions.content:
$HLOGF The London AIM exchange (HE1) is the price discovery market for Helium One. That's where the vast majority of trading takes place and where institutional investors buy and sell. The OTC (HLOGF) and German listings mainly follow London's price, adjusted for exchange rates and local spreads.

So if London is up 10%, the other listings will usually catch up. If the OTC or German price moves on low volume while London is closed, I don't read much into it.

Bottom line: Watch HE1 i
